info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Update Reward Configuration API
info.description: The Update Reward Configuration API enables businesses to modify existing reward configurations for their loyalty programs. With this operation, users can efficiently adjust reward parameters such as points value, eligibility, and expiration details based on changing business strategies or customer feedback. This API is typically utilized by program managers and developers looking to enhance the customer experience within their banking or loyalty platforms. By ensuring accurate and up-to-date reward offerings, businesses can drive customer engagement and satisfaction.
